Newcastle University Vice Chancellor's Excellence Undergraduate Scholarship 2025 is an initiative of Newcastle University for students who wish to study full-time undergraduate courses at the Newcastle University. This scholarship offers 30 awards for outstanding UG applicants from India. The selected students will receive scholarships of 50% of tuition fees.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
hold an offer for an eligible UG degree programme at the University’s Newcastle city centre campus for the 2025/26 academic year
have or expect to receive a minimum of ABB at A level or equivalent
be assessed as international for fee purposes
The selected students will receive 50% tuition fees.
